questions.question: Who launched the inaugural Nagaland Super League 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Neiphiu Rio**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Nagaland Chief Minister Neiphiu Rio inaugurated the Chumoukedima Football Stadium and launched the Nagaland Super League (NSL) on January 28, 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Rio highlighted the significance of the event for Nagaland's sporting community and announced future investments in football infrastructure, including six completed astro-turf fields in six districts.
 
• The NSL aims to provide a platform for players to advance to the Northeast and all-India football leagues. The champion team will qualify for higher competitions.
 
• The league's launch coincides with the legacy of Dr. T. Ao, inspiring young Naga footballers to strive for excellence.
 
• Kalyan Chaubey, President of the All Indian Football Federation, praised the government's support and the large prize pool of ₹1 crore, which aims to motivate players.
 
• Abu Metha, Secretary General of the Nagaland Olympic Association, introduced the 'Football for Schools' initiative, distributing 2,000 footballs to promote grassroots talent across 17 districts.
 
• Keoshu Yimkhiung, Advisor for Youth Resources & Sports, emphasized that the league would not just focus on competition but also inspire and unite the youth of Nagaland.
 
• The opening match of the NSL featured a highly anticipated clash between Barack Football Club and Nagaland United Sports Club.

questions.question: Who won the men's and women's singles titles at the 2025 Australian Open?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jannik Sinner and Madison Keys**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **2025 Australian Open** was held from **January 12–26, 2025**, at **Melbourne Park**, marking the **113th edition** of the tournament and the **first Grand Slam** of the year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The tournament featured events for **professional players** in **singles**, **doubles**, **mixed doubles**, as well as **junior** and **wheelchair competitions**.
 
• **Jannik Sinner** of Italy successfully defended his title in the **men’s singles**, defeating **Alexander Zverev** of Germany with a scoreline of **6–3, 7–6(7–4), 6–3**.
 
• In the **women’s singles**, **Madison Keys** (USA) triumphed over **Aryna Sabalenka**, the two-time defending champion, in a hard-fought match ending **6–3, 2–6, 7–5**.
 
• The **men’s doubles** title was claimed by **Harri Heliövaara (Finland)** and **Henry Patten (UK)** after a thrilling victory over **Simone Bolelli** and **Andrea Vavassori (Italy)** with scores of **6–7(16–18), 7–6(7–5), 6–3**.
 
• In the **women’s doubles**, the team of **Kateřina Siniaková (Czech Republic)** and **Taylor Townsend (USA)** defeated **Hsieh Su-wei** (Chinese Taipei) and **Jeļena Ostapenko** (Latvia) with a score of **6–2, 6–7(4–7), 6–3**.
 
• The **mixed doubles** title was an all-Australian affair, with **Olivia Gadecki** and **John Peers** beating **Kimberly Birrell** and **John-Patrick Smith**, scoring **3–6, 6–4, [10–6]**.
 
• In the **wheelchair men’s singles**, **Alfie Hewett** (UK) defeated **Tokito Oda** (Japan) with a score of **6–4, 6–4**, while **Yui Kamiji** (Japan) won the **wheelchair women’s singles**, defeating **Aniek van Koot** (Netherlands) **6–2, 6–2**.
 
• The **wheelchair quad singles** title was clinched by **Sam Schröder** (Netherlands) after defeating **Niels Vink** (Netherlands) **7–6(9–7), 7–5**.
 
• **Alfie Hewett** and **Gordon Reid** (UK) secured the **wheelchair men’s doubles** by defeating **Daniel Caverzaschi (Spain)** and **Stéphane Houdet (France)** **6–2, 6–4**.
 
• The **wheelchair women’s doubles** winners were **Li Xiaohui** and **Wang Ziying** (China), who triumphed over **Manami Tanaka (Japan)** and **Zhu Zhenzhen (China)** **6–2, 6–3**.
 
• In the **junior boys’ singles**, **Henry Bernet** (Switzerland) emerged victorious over **Benjamin Willwerth** (USA) **6–3, 6–4**, while **Wakana Sonobe** (Japan) dominated **Kristina Penickova** (USA) **6–0, 6–1** to win the **junior girls’ singles**.
 
• The **junior boys’ doubles** was won by **Maxwell Exsted (USA)** and **Jan Kumstát (Czech Republic)** after defeating **Ognjen Milić (Serbia)** and **Egor Pleshivtsev** **7–6(8–6), 6–3**.
 
• The **junior girls’ doubles** title went to **Annika Penickova** and **Kristina Penickova (USA)**, who beat **Emerson Jones (Australia)** and **Hannah Klugman (UK)** **6–4, 6–2**.
 
• **Wheelchair boys’ singles** champion **Charlie Cooper** (USA) defeated **Alexander Lantermann (Belgium)** **6–2, 6–2**, while **Vitória Miranda (Brazil)** claimed the **wheelchair girls’ singles** title with a comeback victory over **Sabina Czauz (USA)** **0–6, 6–3, 7–6(10–4)**.
 
• **Luiz Calixto (Brazil)** and **Charlie Cooper (USA)** won the **wheelchair boys’ doubles**, defeating **Alexander Lantermann (Belgium)** and **Benjamin Wenzel (Australia)** **6–3, 6–0**.
 
• The **wheelchair girls’ doubles** was secured by **Luna Gryp (Belgium)** and **Vitória Miranda (Brazil)**, who overpowered **Sabina Czauz (USA)** and **Ailina Mosko (Latvia)** **6–1, 6–1**.

questions.question: Which government department has partnered with Apna to provide skilled manpower to startups?

options.text: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **DPIIT and Apna** have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to help DPIIT-registered startups hire skilled manpower.
 
• Startups on the **Bhaskar platform** (over 7,00,000 entities) each receive **₹2,000 in hiring credits** on Apna, totaling an initial value of **₹140 crore**.
 
• As the startup ecosystem grows, the initiative’s worth could scale up to **₹300 crore**.
 
• These credits enable startups to post jobs and leverage **AI-driven talent matching** tools.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Partnership Objective**: To provide a robust talent pipeline for India’s booming startup sector.
 
• **Bhaskar Platform**: A DPIIT initiative where 7,00,000 startups are registered, all eligible for hiring credits.
 
• **AI-driven Tools**: Helps startups reach relevant job seekers quickly and efficiently.
 
• **Scalability**: The initial ₹140 crore worth of credits can grow up to ₹300 crore as more startups join.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **DPIIT (Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade)**__

 __
 
• Operates under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
 
• Responsible for formulating and implementing industrial policy, promoting foreign direct investment (FDI), and supporting startups.
 
 
 
• **Apna**__
 
 
• A professional networking and job placement platform designed for India’s workforce.
 
• Utilizes AI technology to match job seekers with employers efficiently.

questions.question: What is the name of the portal launched by SEBI for market infrastructure institutions (MIIs) to report technical glitches?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**iSPOT**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **SEBI has launched a portal called iSPOT to report technical glitches by market infrastructure institutions (MIIs).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The iSPOT portal will be integrated into the SEBI Intermediary (SI) portal for easier access and reporting.**
 
• Starting from February 3, 2025, MIIs will be required to make their submissions related to technical glitches via this portal.
 
• The portal aims to improve data quality, traceability, and compliance monitoring related to technical glitches in MIIs.
 
• The iSPOT portal will also facilitate automated intimation and the submission of Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports by MIIs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)__

 __
 
• SEBI is the regulator for the securities and commodity markets in India, ensuring market integrity and protecting investor interests.
 
• It is responsible for overseeing stock exchanges, mutual funds, and other market intermediaries in India.
 
 
 
• Market Infrastructure Institutions (MIIs)__
 
 
• MIIs include entities like stock exchanges, clearing corporations, and depositories that facilitate the functioning of financial markets.
 
• These institutions play a vital role in the securities market by ensuring transparency and smooth operations.

questions.question: What does "Orange Economy" signify, as discussed in the WAVES 2025 summit?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Cultural, creative, and storytelling industries.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The WAVES 2025 summit emphasized the importance of the Orange Economy, which represents India’s cultural heritage, storytelling tradition, and creative industries.**
 
• It highlights the global significance of India’s soft power, including its rich culture, yoga, Ayurveda, and vibrant creator ecosystem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Orange Economy encompasses industries rooted in creativity, culture, and storytelling, contributing significantly to the global economy.**
 
• India is being positioned as the creative capital of the world through initiatives like WAVES Bazaar and WAH Ustaad.
 
• These initiatives aim to promote India’s soft power and bridge geographical boundaries in the media and entertainment sector.
 
• **WAVES will be the world’s first Audio Visual and Entertainment Summit, **showcasing India’s craft, creativity, talent, and innovation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Orange Economy__

 __
 
• Represents the cultural and creative sectors, including arts, media, and entertainment.
 
• Contributes to economic growth by leveraging cultural heritage and innovation.
 
 
 
• WAVES 2025__
 __
 
• An initiative launched to position India as a leader in the global creative economy.
 
• Includes platforms like WAVES Bazaar for media-related content and talent hunts like WAH Ustaad.
 
 
 
• Soft Power__
 
 
• Refers to the influence a country wields through cultural and creative achievements, rather than military or economic power.
 
• India’s yoga, Ayurveda, and storytelling traditions are key elements of its soft power.

questions.question: Which state's cabinet approved the implementation of the Uniform Civil Code (UCC)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Uttarakhand State Cabinet has approved the implementation of the Uniform Civil Code (UCC).**
 
• The approval of the UCC manual is a step toward ensuring that all citizens are governed by a common set of laws in personal matters.
 
• The move aims to promote equality and justice across the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Uttarakhand Cabinet approved the UCC manual, paving the way for its implementation in the state.**
 
• The UCC aims to provide a uniform set of laws for personal matters such as marriage, inheritance, and adoption.
 
• The primary goal is to promote equality and justice for all citizens, irrespective of religion or community.
 
• Uttarakhand becomes one of the states pursuing the implementation of the Uniform Civil Code in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Uniform Civil Code (UCC)__

 __
 
• A proposal for a common set of laws that govern personal matters such as marriage, divorce, and inheritance for all citizens, irrespective of their religion.
 
• The idea is to ensure equality and justice, particularly for women and marginalized groups.
 
• The UCC is a part of the Directive Principles of State Policy in the Indian Constitution.
 
 
 
• Uttarakhand__
 
 
• Uttarakhand is a state located in the northern part of India.
 
• It is known for its natural beauty and pilgrimage destinations like Haridwar and Rishikesh.

questions.question: Where was the 'One Plate, One Bag' campaign launched to promote a plastic-free Event?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Prayagraj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Maha Kumbh 2025: ‘One Plate, One Bag’ initiative launched to make the event plastic-free

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The campaign is spearheaded by the **Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS)**, introduced by RSS Sah-Sarkaryavah Krishna Gopal at Sector 18, Old GT Road in Prayagraj.
 
• To date, about **70,000 cloth bags** and over **2 million steel plates and glasses** have been distributed nationally to replace single-use plastics at the event.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath** endorsed the campaign, urging pilgrims to adopt eco-friendly habits during the Mahakumbh's inaugural "Amrit Snan."
 
• The campaign promotes sustainable practices by encouraging the use of reusable utensils and cloth bags to reduce plastic pollution at the Mela.

questions.question: Who is the author of the autobiography On That Note: Memories of a Life in Music?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjay Subrahmanyan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **"On That Note"** is the autobiography of Carnatic vocalist **Sanjay Subrahmanyan**, co-authored by **Krupa Ge**, providing insights into his life and artistic journey.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The book explores his evolution from a **reluctant learner to an accomplished artiste**, highlighting the influence of family, mentors, and the socio-cultural milieu of his upbringing in **Mylapore**.
 
• Sanjay reflects on his **post-pandemic career changes**, considering it an apt time to chronicle his five-decade journey in Carnatic music.
 
• The book balances a **concise narrative with rich details**, covering his **growing-up years**, ongoing learning, insecurities, and innovative approaches to his craft.
